messages:
InfraBot: :rotating_light: incident-bot: page fired for pool prod-us-west-1/gpu-a100-rtx-1 — CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL / OOM-rate spike detected (auto-pager).
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: page triggered (PD-INC-99758) — urgent -> oncall rotation.
Mia: acked PD-INC-99758 :white_check_mark: I'm on it, pulling metrics now.
Sam: seeing a sharp spike in token-length and concurrent long-seq requests from route /api/generate — qps x6 for last 90s.
Mia: logs show a lot of cudaMalloc failures:
```
E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:1234] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 3.2GiB
W runtime: kernel slab_alloc failed: chain depth 12, fragmentation high
```
Sam: kvcache eviction rate also skyrocketed — trying to correlate. Could be prefix cache prefetch + long seq.
Jess: customer telemetry: 4 customers experiencing 5xx rate ~ 18% on hosted endpoint redwood-gen-large in us-west-1. Escalating to account team.
Tiago: are we auto-evicting or auto-shedding? I see autoshedder triggered but some GPUs still hitting alloc fail.
Mia: autoshedder logs: `auto-shedder: reroute to fallback-model v1.2.3` but fallback pool saturated.
Sam: quick mitigation options: 1) force route heavy users to smaller-context model (v1-small) 2) increase burst capacity (if spare GPUs available) 3) drain offending nodes and restart agent.
Mia: trying 1) now — injecting routing override for top 5 offending API keys:
```
POST /admin/route_override
{ "keys": ["acct_9a","acct_b3"], "target_model": "redwood-gen-small", "duration_s": 1200 }
```
Mia: sent — responses dropping from 18% -> 9% within 60s.
InfraBot: autoscale: request to allocate 2 additional dedicated GPUs in us-west-1 submitted (req-7741). ETA ~ 90s.
PagerDuty: PD note: Mia acknowledged at 5149990005, Sam added, OpsLead notified.
Sam: while autoscale warms, sending `kubectl drain` to problematic node gpu-node-34: `kubectl drain gpu-node-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Mia: hold — don't evict yet, letting active requests finish; draining now will cause more reroutes. I prefer to wait 30s to let current in-flight finish.
Sam: ok delaying drain. Observability: token latency rising 2x for fallback routes but overall error rate stabilizing.
Jess: noted customers impacted: acct_9a, acct_b3, acct_xc — support pinged with temporary mitigation and ETA ~ 15m.
Tiago: adding temporary KV cache size reduction to stop prefetch blowouts: `REDWOOD_KVCACHE_MAX=512MB` applied to pool.
Mia: applied — eviction rate decreased and cuda alloc errors dropped to near zero.
InfraBot: autoscale completed: 2 new GPU workers joined pool, health checks passed.
Mia: moving from mitigation to recovery. Next steps: keep routing overrides in place for 10 more minutes while backlog drains, schedule controlled restart of node-34 tonight at 02:00 UTC, and open a postmortem.
OpsLead: :eyes: good triage — please file incident ticket INC-2026-342 with timeline, affected customers, and follow-ups (kv-cache prefetch throttling, autoscale tuning, better fallback capacity). Assign to Sam and Mia.
Mia: filing INC-2026-342 now, linking PD-INC-99758 and req-7741.
Sam: quick note for postmortem: add a short-term runbook item to throttle long-context requests by quota bump and autoscale faster to avoid cascade.
Jess: support note drafted and sent to affected customers; watch for regressions.
Mia: leaving handoff to OpsLead for monitoring overnight. Oncall -> OpsLead at 5149990300 :point_right: handing off.
OpsLead: ack — I'll watch 02:00 restart and follow up tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: PD-INC-99758 closed by Mia at 5149990325.
InfraBot: incident-bot: page resolved (auto-pager cleared).
